instruments.budget_regime_provenance: RIA is a lump-sum instrument. CLAUDE.md §8.1 and the C1 amendment record contrast 'lump-sum instruments' (external Lump Sum Budget Planner) with 'unit-cost instruments (e.g. MSCA)'. The RIA application form carries the lump-sum declaration (Declaration 10, 'LUMP SUM GRANTS ONLY') and the D.x lump-sum budget breakdown. Source: af_he-ria-ia_en.pdf Part A pp.5-6, 15-16 of 24.
instruments.phases_in_scope_provenance: RIA runs the full canonical phase sequence (Phases 1-8): consortium/work-package-based drafting requiring call analysis, concept refinement, WP design, gantt/milestones, impact architecture, implementation architecture, budget gate, and drafting/review. Traceable to the manifest node_registry (n01-n08), all of which apply to a consortium RIA.

instruments.budget_regime_provenance: MSCA-PF is a unit-cost instrument (CLAUDE.md §8.1 / C1: 'unit-cost instruments (e.g. MSCA)'). The EU contribution takes the form of unit contributions - living / mobility / family allowances for the recruited researcher plus institutional unit contributions (research-training-networking, management-and-indirect) - per the MSCA Work Programme 2026-2027, '2. MSCA POSTDOCTORAL FELLOWSHIPS, 2.1 Applicable unit contributions' (Decision of 11 March 2021 authorising unit contributions for MSCA). The budget gate (Phase 7) uses the internal deterministic unit-cost derivation (C1), not the external Lump Sum Budget Planner. Rate table: docs/tier2b_topic_and_call_sources/extracted/unit_cost_rates.json. Source: wp-2-marie-sklodowska-curie-actions_horizon-2026-2027_en.pdf pp.78-80 of 112.
instruments.phases_in_scope_provenance: MSCA-PF runs the full canonical phase sequence (Phases 1-8). The DAG topology is unchanged; only the profile behind it differs (brief §2.1). The 'consortium' is a single postdoctoral researcher hosted by a beneficiary (plus an associated partner hosting the outgoing phase for Global Fellowships). Work packages, gantt/milestones, impact architecture, implementation, and the unit-cost budget gate all apply to a fellowship work plan.
